about.title: About me

image.alt: Illustration of a developer working at a laptop

paragraphs: I'm a frontend developer with 4+ years at Tata Consultancy Services. I started on Sitecore-based enterprise websites and now lead a three-person UI team building internal PIM tools and AI chatbots — including the tool that writes product titles and descriptions for Croma.

Most of my work is React, along with API integration, prompt work, and checking AI output before it reaches users. I build responsive, accessible interfaces that match the Figma design down to the spacing.
My goal is to bring concepts to life by crafting websites that are not only visually stunning but also highly functional.

items.title: Senior Frontend Developer — Internal AI Projects
items.focus: Product Information Management (PIM), Croma content tools, AI chatbots
points: Lead a UI team of three on PIM and chatbot projects: plan sprint work, review pull requests and own frontend delivery.
Built the frontend for a PIM tool that generates product titles and descriptions for the Croma catalogue.
Wrote and tuned the prompts behind that copy, and checked generated text against product specs before release.
Built reusable React components shared across internal PIM screens, wired to product and AI-content APIs.

items.title: Frontend Developer — Enterprise CMS Websites
points: Built website pages from Figma designs on Sitecore, using templates and drag-and-drop components.
Wrote custom CSS, JavaScript and jQuery where stock components couldn't handle the design or interactions.
Connected CMS-managed content and APIs so content teams could update text and images without developer help.
Improved page speed and Core Web Vitals with lazy loading, image compression, minification and caching.

items.title: Trainee — Frontend Development
points: Completed TCS training in web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) before the first client assignment.
Built practice projects with React components, hooks and context.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: The questions recruiters and clients ask me most.

items.a: Vinay Kumar Pudi is a Senior Frontend Developer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in Hyderabad, India, with 4+ years of experience building React interfaces for AI products: chatbots, product information management (PIM) tools and virtual try-on.

React and JavaScript frontends for AI-powered products. That includes chatbot interfaces, the PIM tool that generates product titles and descriptions for the Croma catalogue, and the prompt engineering and output checks behind that generated copy.

items.q: Are you available for hire or freelance work?
items.a: Yes. I'm open to senior frontend and UI lead roles, and to freelance projects: React web apps, dashboards, AI chatbot interfaces and fast business websites. The quickest way to reach me is the contact form on this page or vinaypudi1332@gmail.com.

items.q: Where are you based? Do you work remotely?
items.a: I'm based in Hyderabad, India, and I'm open to remote work.

Daily: React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs and Git. In production: PrimeReact, jQuery, Sitecore CMS and Figma. Working knowledge: Node.js, FastAPI, Azure Blob Storage and Cosmos DB, Jest and Testing Library, and CrewAI.

items.q: Have you led a frontend team?
items.a: Yes. I lead a three-person UI team at TCS: planning sprint work, reviewing pull requests and owning frontend delivery for PIM and chatbot projects.

items.q: Where can I get your resume?
items.a: Download it as a PDF from the About or Work with me section on this page.
